work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CLVI separates the Camaldolese hermits of the Kingdom of Naples from the congregation of Monte Corona, restoring Clement XIV’s arrangement, and commits elections to the archbishop of Naples; across running titles LF35717 and LF35785, own provenance LF35782 and page number 243 LF35850; complete 19 December 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF35705–35705; the source closing at LF35882–35885 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die decima nona decembris millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno septimo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
